name: merchant-payments-yarn
description: Yarn commands for hedera-merchant-payments. `install` is named exactly "install" so the harness reuses it across repair attempts while the lockfile fingerprint is unchanged. No command needs live secrets.

commands.name: typecheck-ledger
commands.purpose: Money/state-machine/webhook code must compile under strict TypeScript.

commands.name: test-ledger
commands.purpose: Unit tests for units, memo, invoice state machine and webhook signatures.

commands.name: test-contracts
commands.purpose: Invoice lifecycle, access control, HTS-path guards, expiry, key rotation.

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: Production build of the merchant dashboard + hosted checkout (includes typecheck).
